chunks.text: Electrical Characteristics. Reverse leakage current IR: 50 µA max at VR = 40 V, TJ = 25 °C; 15 mA typical at VR = 24 V, TJ = 85 °C; 40 mA typical at VR = 24 V, TJ = 100 °C. Leakage roughly doubles for every 10 °C rise in junction temperature.
Thermal characteristics: junction-to-ambient thermal resistance 340 °C/W. Reverse leakage power adds to junction heating; at high junction temperature and reverse bias, thermal runaway is possible.
